title: Mahalle memeleri
note: Memeler Dilanur'un listesinden (memes.pdf, 33 madde). Düğmede meme cümlesi yazar; komut aynı sahneyi tek bir çizgi film karakterine canlandırtır. Gerçek kişilerin adı ve görünüşü komutlara girmez. Türkçe seslendirme doğrulanmadı. Kontrat tur başına dört seçenek istediği için 33. meme son turda üç memeyle birlikte tekrar edilir; turlar bitince sunucu turları rastgele tekrarlar.
opening: 3D animated cartoon, bright and funny. One cheerful middle-aged Turkish man with a thick black mustache, a flat cap, a white shirt and a brown knitted vest stands on a colorful Istanbul neighborhood street, in front of a corner shop with a blue wooden door, a small patch of grass and a wooden table. He sips tea from a small tulip glass and looks around, waiting for something to happen. Warm afternoon light. Medium-wide camera. Street ambience. No on-screen text or subtitles.
premise: 3D animated cartoon, bright and funny. One cheerful middle-aged Turkish man with a thick black mustache, a flat cap, a white shirt and a brown knitted vest, on a colorful Istanbul neighborhood street with a corner shop, a blue wooden door, a small patch of grass and a wooden table. Keep the same man and street. Medium-wide camera. No on-screen text or subtitles.
continuation: Big, exaggerated cartoon expressions. Continue from the current moment; do not reset the scene.

choices.label: Sen seçildin Recep
choices.action: A golden beam of light shines down on the man from the sky; he looks up in awe and points at himself as a deep voice booms in Turkish: "Sen seçildin Recep."

choices.label: Çimenlere girme
choices.action: The man tiptoes onto the small patch of grass, then jumps back off in panic and wags his finger, saying in Turkish: "Çimenlere girme!"

choices.label: Yoğurt doldurmak bir sanat işidir
choices.action: The man slowly fills a big tub on the table with thick white yogurt using a ladle, smoothing it like a proud artist, and says in Turkish: "Yoğurt doldurmak bir sanat işidir."

choices.label: Anneeğ
choices.action: The man throws his head back and wails like a small child calling for his mother, mouth wide open, shouting in Turkish: "Anneeğ!"

choices.label: Sayın bezmenler
choices.action: The man stands behind a small wooden podium and gives a very formal, pompous speech with grand hand gestures, saying in Turkish: "Sayın bezmenler!"

choices.label: La gelir misin lütfen
choices.action: The man beckons someone off-screen with his finger, impatient but polite, calling in Turkish: "La gelir misin lütfen."

choices.label: Yalan söyleme yalancı
choices.action: The man frowns and points accusingly at the camera, shaking his finger, saying in Turkish: "Yalan söyleme yalancı!"

choices.label: Yeter artık buramıza geldi ya
choices.action: The man, completely fed up, holds his flat hand under his chin to show he has had enough and sighs, saying in Turkish: "Yeter artık, buramıza geldi ya!"

choices.label: Ya ne anlatıyon be abla
choices.action: The man throws both hands up in confusion and disbelief, shaking his head, saying in Turkish: "Ya ne anlatıyon be abla!"

choices.label: Gene başladı
choices.action: The man rolls his eyes and slaps his forehead in exasperation, saying in Turkish: "Gene başladı."

choices.label: Bu benim kaderim
choices.action: Rain suddenly starts falling only on the man; he looks up at the sky with his hand on his heart, dramatically resigned, saying in Turkish: "Bu benim kaderim."

choices.label: Abi geldiler abi
choices.action: The man runs toward the camera in panic, looking back over his shoulder, shouting in Turkish: "Abi geldiler abi!"

choices.label: Ee sen şimdi naneyi yemedin mi
choices.action: The man holds up a sprig of green mint leaves and stares at it with a slow, suspicious realization, saying in Turkish: "Ee sen şimdi naneyi yemedin mi?"

choices.label: Aç lan gapıyı
choices.action: The man pounds angrily on the blue wooden door with his fist, shouting in Turkish: "Aç lan gapıyı!"

choices.label: Terliyorum
choices.action: The man sweats heavily, wiping his forehead with a handkerchief and fanning himself with his cap, saying in Turkish: "Terliyorum."

choices.label: Çok şükür yarabbi
choices.action: The man raises both open palms to the sky with a huge grateful smile, saying in Turkish: "Çok şükür yarabbi!"

choices.label: Selam sana imparator
choices.action: The man bows deeply with a grand sweeping arm gesture, as if greeting an emperor, saying in Turkish: "Selam sana imparator!"

choices.label: Hemen engellendin koçum
choices.action: The man holds up a smartphone, taps it firmly with one finger and smirks, saying in Turkish: "Hemen engellendin koçum."

choices.label: Nasıl?
choices.action: The man freezes in total shock, jaw dropping and eyes wide open, saying in Turkish: "Nasıl?"

choices.label: Yirmağa gideyrum
choices.action: The man puts a fishing rod over his shoulder and happily marches off down the street, saying in Turkish: "Yirmağa gideyrum!"

choices.label: Noluyor lan kim bu
choices.action: A strange man in a bright tracksuit suddenly appears next to him; the man jumps back startled and stares, saying in Turkish: "Noluyor lan, kim bu?"

choices.label: La bizi kim alabilir
choices.action: The man puffs out his chest, crosses his arms and swaggers with total confidence, saying in Turkish: "La bizi kim alabilir?"

choices.label: Aynen aynen
choices.action: The man nods enthusiastically again and again with a big thumbs up, saying in Turkish: "Aynen aynen."

choices.label: Biz de birileriyiz
choices.action: The man straightens his vest, lifts his chin and stands proudly with dignity, saying in Turkish: "Biz de birileriyiz."

choices.label: Beni ilgilendirmiyor hanımefendi
choices.action: The man turns his back and waves his hand dismissively, not interested at all, saying in Turkish: "Beni ilgilendirmiyor hanımefendi."

choices.label: Alacaksan al beni
choices.action: The man spreads his arms wide and dramatically offers himself, pleading, saying in Turkish: "Alacaksan al beni."

choices.label: Her gün de karşıma çıkıyorsun
choices.action: The same stranger pops up in front of the man again; he throws his hands up in annoyance, saying in Turkish: "Her gün de karşıma çıkıyorsun."

choices.label: İlkkan seni hiç dinlemedim ama bence haksızsın
choices.action: The man covers his ears, shakes his head and wags his finger in disagreement, saying in Turkish: "Seni hiç dinlemedim ama bence haksızsın."

choices.label: Bu halıyı dokuyan çocuk kör oldu
choices.action: The man proudly unrolls a colorful, intricately patterned Turkish carpet on the street and shows it off, saying in Turkish: "Bu halıyı dokuyan çocuk kör oldu."

choices.label: Cama ekmek banmak
choices.action: The man presses a piece of bread against the corner shop window, pretending to dip it into the food displayed behind the glass, and eats it happily.

choices.label: Benim oğlum koronavirüsün ilacını bulmuştur
choices.action: The man proudly holds up a small glowing medicine bottle, beaming like a proud father, saying in Turkish: "Benim oğlum koronavirüsün ilacını bulmuştur."

choices.label: Yalnız penguen
choices.action: A lonely little penguin waddles slowly across the street all alone; the man watches it with a sad, sympathetic face.

choices.label: Bonibon yiyen fare
choices.action: A tiny mouse sits on the wooden table eating colorful candy-coated chocolates one by one; the man leans in and watches, amazed.

choices.label: Aç lan gapıyı
choices.action: The man pounds angrily on the blue wooden door with his fist, shouting in Turkish: "Aç lan gapıyı!"

choices.label: Nasıl?
choices.action: The man freezes in total shock, jaw dropping and eyes wide open, saying in Turkish: "Nasıl?"
